delay_imposed_on_others.criterion: prediction within 1.5x of measured, or within 0.1 s absolute for small values, for at least 90 % of HOLDOUT triples

ranking.criterion: within each background condition, the predicted ordering of actions matches the measured ordering for at least 90 % of action pairs whose measured values differ by more than 2x

job_completion_time.criterion: median absolute relative error at most 20 %

noise.definition: |sum over matched background requests of TTFT(independent repeat of the without-run) - TTFT(without)|, the same quantity the experiment reports as the imposed delay

noise_against_criteria.criterion_iii_noise: NOT AVAILABLE: the action's own completion time was measured once per arm and StudyENG1 ran no repeat of the with-arm, so there is no repeat-based noise estimate for criterion (iii)
noise_against_criteria.criterion_ii_noise: the ranking criterion is evaluated on per-cell MEDIANS over trials, so the relevant noise is the median's, not a single trial's; the per-cell repeat spread is reported in `noise`
noise_against_criteria.note: the two measurements differ ONLY by run-to-run noise, so a pair that fails criterion (i) is a pair the criterion would reject even from a perfect prediction

engine.fit_data: Part A (A_E0) and Part B E0 (B_E0) steps; Part C (incl. HOLDOUT) not used

assertions: every scored trial's (load, action, trial) is absent from the split file
the number of excluded trials equals the split file's size
every triple in the split file is present in the record and excluded

split: Part C FIT trials. FIT TRIALS, NOT HELD OUT. The three StudyPOL4 terms were fitted on StudyENG1 Parts A, B and D and on StudyENG1b, so no coefficient saw a Part C trial; but these 406 FIT trials informed the ATTRIBUTION that chose which terms to add (reports/study_t0_fidelity.md section 11) and carried two earlier implementation fixes, so this re-score is IN-SAMPLE FOR THE CHOICE OF TERMS and is not a test of the revised model. StudyT0b on fresh data is.

eng1b.criterion: none/partial/total class correct for at least 90 % of trials; also report MAE of fraction lost
eng1b.evidence_strength: WEAKER THAN THE HOLDOUT TEST: StudyENG1b has no held-out split, so these 852 trials are the whole study. No parameter used here was fitted on ENG1b and its measured staircase was not called, but the trials are not a held-out sample
